hero.title: welcome to lleida
hero.subtitle: a small city where everything is walkable, in the middle of catalonia.
hero.description: if you have an iaeste placement in lleida, or you are considering one, this is what the city is like, what there is to do, and what we help you with once you arrive.
hero.alt: lleida's rambla ferran with the old cathedral crowning the hill behind it.

city.title: what lleida is like
city.description: lleida has around 140,000 people and you can walk across it end to end. barcelona is a little over an hour away by high-speed train and the pyrenees are half an hour by car, so it works for a weekend in the city as easily as one in the mountains. the universitat de lleida has its campuses in the centre and in cappont, across the river segre.

old-town.title: la seu vella and the old town
old-town.description: the old cathedral crowns the hill you can see from anywhere in the city. below it, the shopping street and the old town.
old-town.alt: lleida's old cathedral on its hilltop, with the walls in front of it.

river.title: the banks of the segre
river.description: the park along the river runs the whole length of the city — it is where people run, cycle and walk.
river.alt: a path among trees in la mitjana park, beside the river segre.

mountains.title: the pyrenees nearby
mountains.description: skiing in winter and hiking in summer, a little over an hour away.
mountains.alt: lake sant maurici in the lleida pyrenees, ringed by peaks and pines.

food.title: food and festivals
food.description: snails, olive oil from les garrigues and fruit from the plain. the aplec del cargol in may is the city's biggest festival.
food.alt: a tin of grilled snails, the dish lleida is known for.

support.title: what we help with
support.description: iaeste lc lleida is a committee of student volunteers. we are not an agency — we help with the things we have been through ourselves.

arrival.title: arrival and paperwork
arrival.description: we point you through the paperwork you need to do when you arrive and what the university needs from you.

housing.title: housing
housing.description: we help you look for somewhere to live and pass on the contacts we know.

social.title: activities
social.description: when we can, we organise trips and meet-ups with the committee and other exchange students. not all year round.

apply.title: how to get a placement
apply.description: iaeste placements are not applied for in lleida. you apply through the iaeste committee in your own country, which handles applications and the exchange itself. find your committee on iaeste.org and write to them.
apply.contactNote: already placed in lleida, or have a specific question? write to us.
